newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: DCC pays deferred payment of 4.046 mln punts.
newsitem.headline: DCC pays deferred payment of 4.046 mln punts.

text.p: DCC Plc said on Thursday that it has paid a deferred consideration of 4.046 million Irish pounds due following the increase in its stake in International Translation and Publishing Ltd.
DCC raised its stake to 90 percent from 44.5 percent in August 1996, it said in a statement.

DCC said the total cost of the increased shareholding amounted to 4.343 million Irish pounds which was based on a valuation of ITP of 6.5 times its average earnings after tax and preference dividends for the two years ended March 31 1997.
An initial consideration of 0.297 million was paid in August 1996, it said.

DCC's shareholding in ITP is held through its wholly-owned subsidiary Printech International with Forbairt, the Irish State agency for indigenous industry development, holding the remaining 10 percent.
